newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-VALMIERA PLANS 600,000 LATS PROFIT, SHARE ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-VALMIERA PLANS 600,000 LATS PROFIT, SHARE ISSUE.

text.p: Valmiera Glassfibre factory said on Monday that it plans to earn some 600,000 lats in 1997 against 164,813 in 1996.
Valmiera shareholders also decided on a closed issue of 1.127 million shares with a nominal value of one lat.

"The shareholders meeting (on April 19) approved this year's budget with after-tax profit of some 600,000 lats and sales volume not lower than 1996," Imant Saulitis, Valmiera's finance manager, told Reuters.
Saulitis said that Glasseiden Gmbh Oschatz, a 49 percent controlling stock owner in Valmiera, decided to invest 1.2 million lats during 1997 in finishing equipment.
"This is equipment necessary to improve the quality of our end-product, glass-fibre textile and isolation materials," Saulitis said. "This would also widen our range"
The total investment planned by 1999 is three million lats, Saulitis said.
"It will be a matter of investing in equipment for glass production itself in the coming years," Saulitis said.
The share issue will be based on the amount of debt that the company owed to the state and which was capitalised.
The privatisation agency is to decide on the price of this issue in a month, based on the average bourse price during the last quarter, Saulitis said.
"We now have a month to register the issue with the company register," he added.
Some 74 percent of the price will be paid in cash and 25 percent in vouchers.
The issue will first be offered to existing shareholders and the board will decide on the subscription period.
